title:
Epic to clean up the Preview and Select Data step after completion. Clicked items in the tree view will have already
gone through the flow where the related {@link SourceCollection}s and source types get created. If any item in the
tree was clicked, but not checked (or checked and then unchecked), this epic will tear down the related metadata, as
it'sassumed that these are temporary drafts. In addition to removing stale metadata this will clear local state so
the components are clean for the next time they render.
name: AllCompletePreviewAndSelectDataStepEpic
